notes: counts key ids only — per-key rows are entity_id + name_key_sha256 + counts; no registrant name or label leaves the audit report (Part VIII)
this row measures; it never decides — every disposition is the operator's (OP-15), and D-P32.3-1 stays OPEN until they land

keep.basis: split_count == 1 — single-source keys whose global union was harmless (the 'keep the entity' OP-15 option)

same_as.basis: not sized by this query — the audit report carries no strong-identifier joinability; the 'same_as' OP-15 option needs a strong-id census the packet honestly does not claim

split.basis: split_count > 1 — multi-source keys; each decomposes into its reported sig.org.name_scoped candidates (the auto-union exposure the OP-15 'split' option reviews)

query.note: the verbatim provenance SELECT of resolution.partner_name_audit.name_scope_report — every count in this packet derives from exactly this query
query.sql:
SELECT ei.value AS name_key,
       e.entity_id::text,
       o.cached_canonical_name AS label,
       ea.source_id,
       c.predicate_id
  FROM entity_identifier ei
  JOIN entity e ON e.entity_id = ei.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.entity_id = e.entity_id
  JOIN claim c ON c.object_entity = e.entity_id AND c.object_type = 'entity_ref'
  JOIN claim_evidence ce ON ce.claim_id = c.claim_id
  JOIN evidence_capture ec ON ec.capture_id = ce.capture_id
  JOIN evidence_artifact ea ON ea.artifact_id = ec.artifact_id
 WHERE ei.scheme = %s
 ORDER BY ei.value, ea.source_id, c.predicate_id
